fn:constantTimeEq.cost: O(min length); unequal lengths give false without comparing contents.

fn:hmacSha256.cost: O(key + message) native work; keys longer than 64 bytes are hashed first; 32-byte tag (RFC 2104).
fn:hmacSha256.failure: StdError Limit (key or message over 1 MiB).

fn:pbkdf2Sha256.cost: O(iterations * 64 + length) native work, charged up front; the largest call is 1000000 iterations.
fn:pbkdf2Sha256.failure: StdError Range (iterations outside 1..1000000, length outside 1..1024, salt outside 1..1024 bytes) / Limit (password over 1 MiB).

fn:sha256.cost: O(bytes) native work, 4 units per input byte; 32-byte digest.

fn:sha512.cost: O(bytes) native work, 4 units per input byte; 64-byte digest.
